description: This file contains C# source code defining classes, interfaces, and extension methods related to Orleans memory grain storage, including options, validators, storage implementations, and extension methods for configuring storage in a silo builder.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for in-memory grain storage, including serializer, init stage, and number of storage grains.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for MemoryGrainStorageOptions to ensure configuration correctness.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorage
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainStorage for in-memory storage, supporting async read, write, and clear operations.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of MemoryGrainStorage.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency
classes.description: Extended in-memory storage class that supports latency simulation and mock calls.

classes.name: MemoryStorageWithLatencyOptions
classes.description: Options class for MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency, including latency duration and mock call flag.

methods.name: AddMemoryGrainStorage
methods.description: Extension method to add memory grain storage to the silo builder with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddMemoryGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Extension method to add memory grain storage as default in the silo builder.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a MemoryGrainStorage instance.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to clear grain state.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to read grain state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to write grain state.
